goal: Defeat Team Rocket in Silph Co.

subgoals.goal_text: Travel from Vermilion City to Saffron City.
Enter the Silph Co. building in Saffron City.
Defeat the Team Rocket grunts on the first floor and reach the elevator.
Go to the second floor and defeat the Team Rocket grunts there.
Go to the third floor and defeat the Team Rocket grunts there.
Go to the fourth floor and defeat the Team Rocket grunts there.
Go to the fifth floor and defeat the Team Rocket grunts there.
Use the elevator to reach the top floor of Silph Co.
Locate and defeat Giovanni in the Silph Co. headquarters.
